meta.source: Public X posts & YouTube only (data.json is sole source of truth; Google Sheet retired)

edgeCoding.attacks: Source publicly criticizes, mocks, or campaigns against target (posts, streams, reaction content)
edgeCoding.defends: Source publicly supports target against critics or endorses their side in the conflict
edgeCoding.collaborates: Joint livestream/content, co-hosting, or clear working alliance (not mere agreement)
edgeCoding.past_collab: Documented collaboration that predated the conflict (kept even if relationship later broke)
edgeCoding.debates: Formal live debate that actually occurred (not merely scheduled or discussed)
edgeCoding.blocks: Public discussion of blocking / hard social cutoff
edgeCoding.questions: Engagement without clear camp loyalty (pushback, inquiry, fatigue)

meta.notes: Direction is always source → target. Cluster is a snapshot of primary camp alignment at last update; edges capture history including realignments.
meta.avatars: Nodes with a valid X handle (or optional 'avatar' username / 'image' URL) render as circular profile photos via unavatar.io. Nodes without handles keep geometric shapes.
